units.source_text: 我急忙赶路，仿佛快要赶不上八点的遥拜式似的。

en.t: I hurried along, as if I were about to be late for the eight o'clock worship ceremony.

units.source_text: 木屐的带子都弄断了（我上中学时是穿和服的）。

en.t: Even the straps of my wooden clogs broke (when I was in middle school, I wore a kimono).

units.source_text: 我垂头丧气地折回家里。
美代意外地说，这是迷信，并鼓励了我。

en.t: Unexpectedly, Miyo said that this was just superstition and encouraged me.

units.source_text: 我换了木屐，又匆匆地赶到学校去了。

en.t: I changed my wooden clogs and hurried off to school again.
